Settings.Name: Physical Dice Mod
Settings.Default:
Version 1.1.0

Allows you to use physical dice rolls in Baldur's Gate 3.

How to use:
1. Roll your physical d20
2. Set the value using the slider or hotkeys
3. Press Apply Roll hotkey (F9) or let it auto-apply
4. Make your in-game roll

Console commands still work:
!setroll <1-20> - Set roll value
!checkroll - Check status
!clearroll - Clear boost
